WITH f AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id, valid_from) same_vf
 FROM dim_member)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) joins, count(DISTINCT member_id) dm, max(same_vf) maxsame, sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) online
FROM f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.join_date
WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member)
SELECT d.fiscal_period_label, count(*) joins, sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) online
FROM f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.join_date
WHERE rn=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member),
nm AS (
 SELECT f.home_store_id AS store_id, count(*) new_members, min(join_date) first_join, max(join_date) last_join
 FROM f WHERE rn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, nm.new_members, nm.first_join, nm.last_join
FROM dim_store s LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.is_current ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH f AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member)
SELECT 'refit' k, f.home_store_id, count(*) n FROM f JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=f.home_store_id AND f.join_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date
WHERE rn=1 AND f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'holiday_closed_store', f.home_store_id, count(*) FROM f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.join_date
WHERE rn=1 AND f.home_store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day AND f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closed_store_after_close', f.home_store_id, count(*) FROM f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=f.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE rn=1 AND s.close_date IS NOT NULL AND f.join_date>s.close_date GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'before_open', f.home_store_id, count(*) FROM f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=f.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE rn=1 AND s.open_date IS NOT NULL AND f.join_date<s.open_date GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH first_version AS (
    -- each member's first dim_member version: the store where they enrolled
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS new_members
FROM first_version m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.version_no = 1
  AND m.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'   -- FY2025/26 incl. week 53
  AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
